_how: Pins placed by hand for addresses no geocoder finds. Every run applies them before geocoding, and nothing overwrites them.
query: copy it from the job's '✗ no match' line, the part after the dash.
at: on openstreetmap.org, right-click the building, choose 'Show address', and copy the 'latitude, longitude' from the search box.
The entries below were placed on Kentucky's 911 road centerlines (kygisserver.ky.gov, Ky_911_Road_Centerlines), by the house-number range of the road segment.
Leave 'at' empty to leave a place off the map. Removing an entry later does not remove a pin already placed.
